channel.title: Decide Football
channel.description: The decisions behind world football: team selection, tactics, substitutions, squad calls and the managers under pressure.

item.title: Aston Villa and Unai Emery commit beyond 2029 as new deal talks continue
item.description: Aston Villa say chairman Nassef Sawiris and Unai Emery have reached a clear commitment beyond 2029. Fabrizio Romano reports a new contract is moving to the final stages, while BBC Sport says fine details are still being settled and an announcement is unlikely before the weekend.

item.title: Reedijk's Wide-Left Call on Boyle Pays Off as Hibs Beat Hearts at Hampden
item.description: Hibs head coach Marink Reedijk, who had taken the captaincy from Martin Boyle, played him in an unfamiliar wide-left role in the Premier Sports Cup semi-final, and Boyle scored in a 2-1 win over Hearts.

item.title: Iraola Defends Five Changes After Liverpool Lose 3-2 at Fenerbahçe in the Champions League
item.description: Andoni Iraola benched Wirtz, Isak and Gakpo for Liverpool's Champions League trip to Fenerbahçe and insisted rotation was not why they lost 3-2, blaming three set-piece goals.

item.title: Klopp Recalls Füllkrug and Hands Mohya, 17, a First Germany Call-Up for the Nations League
item.description: Jürgen Klopp has named a 24-man Germany squad for the Nations League games against Serbia and the Netherlands, recalling Bundesliga top scorer Niclas Füllkrug and calling up 17-year-old Wael Mohya.

item.title: Allegri Rules Out Punitive Ritiro After Porto Thrash Napoli 4-1 in the Champions League
item.description: Massimiliano Allegri said Napoli will not go into a ritiro after a 4-1 Champions League defeat at Porto, blaming set pieces and fatigue ahead of Serie A leaders Lazio.

item.title: Carrick's Shea Lacey Substitution Turns Manchester United's Champions League Comeback Against Roma
item.description: Michael Carrick brought on 19-year-old Shea Lacey at 2-1 down against Roma, and the academy graduate set up Matheus Cunha's winner in a 3-2 Champions League victory.

item.title: West Ham Appoint Scott Parker as Head Coach After Sacking Nuno
item.description: West Ham have named Scott Parker head coach on a two-and-a-half-year deal, with his first Championship match away at Cardiff City on Wednesday.

item.title: Bruno Fernandes Backs Carrick’s Call to Drop Him After Roma Comeback
item.description: Manchester United captain Bruno Fernandes says Michael Carrick was right to bench him after his tactics criticism, following the 3-2 Champions League win over Roma.

item.title: Danks Faces Neuer and Olise Calls for Bayern’s Atlético Champions League Trip
item.description: Interim Bayern Munich coach Aaron Danks must decide whether returning players Manuel Neuer and Michael Olise are ready to start against Atlético Madrid.

item.title: How Arteta's game plan stopped Liverpool from landing a shot on target at Anfield
item.description: Arsenal scored early through Kai Havertz, then shut Liverpool out – 17 attempts, none on target – to win at Anfield for the first time since 2012.

item.title: Carrick under pressure: the Martinez question and a nine-game winless run
item.description: Manchester United are winless in nine and 17th in the Premier League. Michael Carrick insists the dressing room is in a good place.
